faqs.q: What is a bimetal thermometer and thermowell pair with a 1/2-inch NPT connection used for?
faqs.a: It is a matched bimetal thermometer and SS316 thermowell pair for measuring fluid temperature on high-pressure lines, with a 1/2-inch NPT male connection and an API 6A P+U temperature range of -20 °F to +250 °F. See the [thermometers and thermowells shelf](/c/ic-thermometers-thermowells).

faqs.q: What temperature range does the bimetal thermometer cover?
faqs.a: An API 6A P+U range of -20 °F to +250 °F. Choose a stem length of 2.5, 4, 6 or 9 inch. Send us the details and we confirm the specification before supply.

faqs.q: What stem lengths does the bimetal thermometer come in?
faqs.a: The stem length is selectable at 2.5, 4, 6 or 9 inch. Pick the one that reaches the middle of the flow in the well. Share the duty and any standard that applies and we will confirm the match.

faqs.q: What pressure can the thermowell take?
faqs.a: The pressure rating is up to 15,000 psi at the process side, with selectable bore size. The thermowell is integral construction. Send us the details and we confirm the specification before supply.

faqs.q: What material are the thermowell and thermometer?
faqs.a: The thermowell is SS316 integral construction, and an SS304 wetted-parts variant is available. The connections are 1/2-inch NPT male to female.

faqs.q: What does API 6A P+U mean on the thermometer?
faqs.a: The listing gives P+U as the API 6A temperature range, -20 °F to +250 °F. API 6A defines temperature classes for wellhead equipment. If you are unsure, send us the requirement and we will confirm.

faqs.q: Why use a thermowell with a thermometer?
faqs.a: The thermowell holds the thermometer stem in the line so the thermometer can be removed without depressurising. The thermowell is sized to match the thermometer stem.

faqs.q: How do I fit the thermowell and thermometer?
faqs.a: Screw the thermowell into the line connection, then screw the thermometer stem into it. See the [oilfield instrumentation guide](/blog/oilfield-pressure-and-flow-instrumentation). If you are unsure, send us the requirement and we will confirm.

faqs.q: What do I need to tell Indus to quote the the bimetal thermometer and thermowell pair?
faqs.a: Quote the full title, Bimetal Thermometer + Thermowell Pair, 1/2-inch NPT M×F, P+U API 6A Range, SS316, with the variant, size or voltage you need, and say where it will be used and which standard or zone applies. We confirm the specification and lead time on the quotation; start on [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: Where are the bimetal thermometers used?
faqs.a: On wellhead, frac and cementing lines where fluid temperature must be checked locally. Pair them with the [pressure sensors](/c/ic-analogic-pressure-sensors) on the same unit.

faqs.q: Where is the thermometer and thermowell pair supplied from?
faqs.a: We supply it from Dubai, UAE and ship worldwide. Send the stem length and connection. If you are unsure, send us the requirement and we will confirm.

faqs.q: Is the bimetal thermometer and thermowell pair in stock in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. We keep the bimetal thermometer and thermowell pair in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the part numbers and quantities through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.
